title: Miniature beam steam engine with crank, piston and valve linkage
curation_status: downloaded_and_structurally_inspected; repository MIT license with embedded metadata discrepancy disclosed
scope: Source curation/download and read-only ZIP/XML inventory only. No geometry conversion, repair, new physics, benchmark arm, or simulation was performed.

source.author: Ken Friedl (KenFilms)
source.format: FreeCAD FCStd ZIP with parametric model, embedded OpenCascade BREP and Assembly4 placement expressions
source.source_claim: CAD reconstructed from the author's measurements of a real miniature beam steam engine originally designed by Lutz Hielscher; author explicitly says inaccurate and missing some parts; educational video model.

license.obligation: Retain the copyright and permission notice with copies or substantial portions.
license.metadata_discrepancy: FCStd Document.xml retains All rights reserved while the public repository supplies an explicit MIT LICENSE. Both evidence items are preserved; the curation does not silently rewrite or resolve that discrepancy.
license.physical_original_design_note: README credits original physical miniature engine design to Lutz Hielscher; the CAD is the repository author's measurement-based reconstruction.

units.basis: FreeCAD native length convention; XML length fields use App::PropertyLength. Official Units documentation demonstrates numeric 10 becoming 10 mm in Part.makeBox.
units.verification_limit: No kernel recompute or measured CAD bounds was performed.

principal_mechanical_groups: fixed base, cylinder and bearing supports
spoked flywheel / shaft / small wheel / crank pieces
small beam and middle beam valve linkage
part_structure.annotation_geometry_present: arrow_in body is an educational flow arrow, not a physical mechanism part; left unmodified in the source

non_simready_evidence.natural_source_category: CAD demonstration assembly with skeleton-sketch and placement-driven kinematics
non_simready_evidence.driver_variable: Variables.Angle_disk drives two sketch constraints; App::Link placements derive from LCS placements
non_simready_evidence.physical_property_name_scan: No XML property name containing mass, density, inertia, collision, friction, restitution, or joint was found. This is a targeted textual inventory, not a semantic proof of absence.
missing_for_dynamic_use: physical revolute/prismatic/loop-closure joints with axes and limits
force/torque actuation, integration and acceptance settings
source_limitations: Measurement-based and incomplete per author README
Saved geometric constraints and animation are not physical force-response validation
Annotation arrow and CAD construction objects need classification before physical asset authoring

proposed_solver_dynamics.mechanism: A beam-engine linkage with a grounded base, piston slider, rocking beam, connecting rod, crank/flywheel and coupled valve linkage. Closed-chain topology must be confirmed from remote CAD inspection before physics authoring.
proposed_solver_dynamics.solver_requirement: Constrained multibody rigid-body solver supporting revolute/prismatic constraints and closed kinematic loops, driven by bounded torque rather than prescribed transforms.
proposed_solver_dynamics.input: Bounded shaft torque or initial flywheel angular velocity, plus an explicit load/damping condition. Thermodynamic steam pressure is outside this asset curation.
observables: flywheel angle and angular velocity over time
piston displacement, stroke extrema and phase relative to flywheel
beam angle and valve linkage phase
unintended contact penetration or disconnected motion
torque versus acceleration and coast-down under a load change
numerical stability, finite state and bounded energy drift
proposed_solver_dynamics.physical_response_discriminator: The same initial state should respond differently to added shaft load or inertia. Prescribed CAD placement animation cannot serve as the dynamics result.

inspection.method: inspect_source.py; Python standard library ZIP/XML only; source screenshot viewed
inspection.visual_review: Source screenshot shows base, piston/cylinder, main beam, flywheel/crank connecting linkage, valve linkage and a nonphysical arrow annotation. This source screenshot is not a render produced by this run.
inspection.compute: local bounded file download and structural inventory; all future conversion and simulation deferred to parent's full 4-GPU Horde node

alternative_considered.reason_not_selected: Tree has SolidWorks SLDASM/SLDPRT files with no STEP/FCStd/STL neutral geometry, plus numerous COTS components; the single FCStd beam engine is more practical for the requested later workflow.
